source_text: Aut vi rapuerit aut calumniam fecerit. Rapina et fraus unum altare polluunt. Convertimini qui opprimitis.
pass_a_gloss: Or by-force will-have-seized or false-charge will-have-made. Robbery and fraud one altar pollute. Be-converted who oppress.
pass_b_english: Or he [[seizes by force or oppresses with a false claim >> Bible:Leviticus 6:2]]. Robbery and fraud defile one altar. Turn, you who oppress.
